values.summary: Create the typed lifecycle record, repair the idempotency and durability defects found by review, rerun focused proof, push the remediation branch, and re-check PR #597 without touching main.

steps.action: Create canonical typed six-card lifecycle state for #596.
Verify and preserve PR #597 linkage so it closes #596 only and marks #505/#534 as Part-Of.
Make typed PR update idempotency operation-key bound and add regression proof.
Close the v3 durable projection crash window and add regression proof.
Run focused validation, push, and refresh PR #597 readback.

invariants: Primary checkout remains clean on main
V2 remains the only live lifecycle authority
Durable recovery must fail closed after committed state but missing projections
Operation keys must be replay-safe and conflict-detecting
risks: Leaving PR transport as caller-forgeable or replay-unsafe
Claiming v3 cutover before independent #505 review
Recording local canaries as stronger evidence than they are
stop_conditions: Primary checkout is no longer clean on main
Typed C-SDLC v2 owner refuses required lifecycle mutation
Fix requires widening beyond sprint remediation
